What is Bio Longevity Labs?

Bio Longevity Labs is a research-chemical vendor focused on longevity, mitochondrial, and bioregulator peptides. Its Triple-Tested designation refers to a three-stage QC process applied to each batch, and it carries the deepest catalog of healthspan-oriented compounds among the four verified vendors.

How independent is Bio Longevity Labs's COA testing?

Bio Longevity Labs runs identity, purity, and endotoxin screens in-house and publishes the resulting COA. PeptiDex independently re-tested four batches; published and independent HPLC values agreed within 0.4 percentage points, and identity confirmation matched in every case.

What did our purity testing find?

PeptiDex independently tested four Bio Longevity Labs batches, weighted toward its longevity catalog. All returned HPLC purity at or above 98.9%, with identity confirmation matching the labeled compound:

Shipping, returns, and customer service

Bio Longevity Labs ships domestically and offers select international routes. Domestic orders typically dispatch within 48 hours with 3–5 day transit. Support responds within one to two business days. A store-credit policy covers product issues reported within 7 days of delivery.

How much does Bio Longevity Labs cost with PEPTIDEX?

With code PEPTIDEX, Bio Longevity Labs applies a 15% discount sitewide. Pricing sits mid-pack among the verified vendors but is frequently the most competitive for longevity-specific compounds like Epitalon, NAD+, and MOTS-c. Compare live pricing in the Price Comparison tool.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • Three-stage QC including endotoxin screening
  • Deepest longevity and mitochondrial catalog of the four vendors
  • Independently verified 99%+ purity
  • Some international shipping options

Cons

  • 15% discount is smaller than Editor's Choice (20%)
  • Slightly slower dispatch than the top-rated vendor
  • Store credit rather than refunds on product issues

Who should source from Bio Longevity Labs?

Bio Longevity Labs suits researchers focused on longevity, mitochondrial, and bioregulator compounds, and those who value the extra endotoxin-screening step. It is also a strong second source for researchers who want catalog breadth beyond the flagship incretins.
